text: The repair man promised to come on Monday, then Tuesday, and still has not shown up. I am livid about being messed around like this.
There is a lump in my throat that will not go away. I sit in silence most evenings, and tears come without warning.
I am grinning from ear to ear today. Everything seems light and bright, and I cannot stop humming my favourite tunes.
Lately I move through each day like a ghost. Nothing brings any spark, and the evenings are the hardest part of all.
I feel heavy and slow today. I have been staring at the wall for hours, and nothing seems worth the effort anymore.
The train was cancelled again this morning without a single announcement. It is outrageous how badly that line is run, week after week.
I am logged in and ready. The keyboard works, the screen is bright enough, and the room is at a normal temperature.
I am gripping this desk so hard my knuckles are white. I could scream at the next tiny thing that goes wrong.
The website crashed right as I submitted my form and wiped everything I had typed. That kind of careless design infuriates me.
There is so much warmth in my chest right now. I have been laughing and singing to myself since I woke up.
It is an ordinary afternoon here. I am reading the instructions on the screen and will answer once I have read them.
A delivery company lost my parcel and then claimed it was my fault. I am still seething about how they handled the whole thing.
My neighbour's car alarm went off for two hours last night and nobody did anything. I still cannot believe how inconsiderate that was.
I am bouncing on my toes like a child. The sky looks brighter than usual, and I cannot wipe this smile off my face.
There is a pounding in my temples and my teeth are grinding. I have no tolerance left for anything or anyone today.
The council dug up our street again and then left it like that for weeks. It makes my blood boil just thinking about it.
This is a regular weekday for me. I am seated, the screen is on, and there is a pen and notebook beside me.
My flatmate used up all the hot water again without asking. It has happened every day this week, and it drives me up the wall.
Someone pushed in front of the whole queue at the post office this morning, and the staff just let it happen. Outrageous.
Honestly, I am boiling inside right now. My heart is pounding, my shoulders are tight, and I want to slam a door.
